name: browser-use
summary: Open-source Python library that lets an LLM drive a browser, plus Browser Use Cloud, a hosted service with stealth browsers and an agent API. Agents can run against a local Chrome (including your own profile) or remote browsers over CDP.
facts: Browser Use (founded 2024 by Magnus Müller and Gregor Žunič)
OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Ollama, own bu-2-0 model
$0.02 per browser-hour; agents at token cost + 20%
goodFor: Python agents that need a browser
watchOut: Best results steer you toward its own paid model
Proxies and CAPTCHA solving need the cloud
